# opencode-v2-gemini-usage-billing

> **OpenCode V2 plugin** for real-time tracking of **Google Gemini API Key Usage, Sliding-Window Rate Limits (RPM, TPM, RPD), Spend (USD / IDR), and Google Cloud Billing**.

Designed specifically for developers using Google Gemini models (`gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, etc.) in OpenCode V2.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔑 **Automatic Gemini Auth Discovery**: Reads your configured Google credentials directly from OpenCode's local database (`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`) or fallbacks to environment variables (`GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_API_KEY`).
- ⚡ **Live Reactive Sliding-Window Rate Limits**:
  - Real-time 60-second sliding window for **Requests Per Minute (RPM)** and **Tokens Per Minute (TPM)** with an instant 1-second clock decay.
  - Accounts for full input context throughput including **Prompt Context Caching (`cache.read`)** matching Google AI Studio calculations.
  - Daily request quota tracking (**RPD**) reset at midnight Pacific Time.
- 🎨 **Dynamic Color Saturation Meters**:
  - Visual mini saturation meters (`[████░░]`) matching OpenCode's semantic theme tokens.
  - **🟢 Green** (`< 65%`): Normal safe operating capacity.
  - **🟠 Amber** (`65%–85%`): High throughput approaching limit.
  - **🔴 Red** (`> 85%`): Near quota limit / throttled.
- 🏷️ **Tier-Level Awareness**:
  - Automatically identifies Gemini tier: **Free**, **Tier 1**, **Tier 2**, or **Tier 3** based on model access and spend history.
  - Model-specific rate limits for `gemini-3.8-flash` (2M TPM, 1k RPM in Tier 1 per Google AI Studio specifications).
  - Custom quota overrides via `GEMINI_TPM_LIMIT`, `GEMINI_RPM_LIMIT`, and `GEMINI_RPD_LIMIT`.
- 💰 **Accurate Spend & Google Cloud Billing Synchronization**:
  - Real-time session spend bound directly to OpenCode's in-memory session store (`context.data.session.cost`).
  - Tiered spend overview: **Current Session**, **Today**, **This Month**, and **All-Time**.
  - **Google Cloud ADC Integration**: Discovers active Google Cloud billing accounts via authenticated `gcloud` credentials, automatically localizing spend into **IDR (Indonesian Rupiah)** matching Google AI Studio's billing dashboard.
- 🖥️ **OpenCode TUI Integration**:
  - **Collapsible Sidebar Widget** (`sidebar.content`): Clean, narrow-sidebar safe layout (~25–29 characters) with persistent collapse state via `context.storage.store`.
  - **Footer Status Bar** (`home.footer.status`): Lightweight real-time ticker showing current spend and RPM.
- 🤖 **Agent Tool (`gemini_usage_report`)**:
  - Exposes an OpenCode server tool allowing agents to programmatically query live usage, active rate limits, and billing metrics.

---

## 🚀 Installation & Setup

### 1. Install Plugin
Add `opencode-v2-gemini-usage-billing` to your `opencode.json(c)`:

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-v2-gemini-usage-billing"
  ]
}
```

Or for global terminal TUI access in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    "opencode-v2-gemini-usage-billing"
  ]
}
```

### 2. Gemini Authentication
This plugin automatically retrieves your Google API Key from OpenCode's database:
- `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (`credential` table where `integration_id = 'google'`)

Alternatively, you can export environment variables:
```bash
export GEMINI_API_KEY="AIzaSy..."
# or
export GOOGLE_API_KEY="AIzaSy..."
```

## ⚙️ Environment Variables & Overrides

| Variable | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `GEMINI_TIER` | Force tier level (`tier1`, `tier2`, `tier3`, `free`) | Auto-detected |
| `GEMINI_TPM_LIMIT` | Override Tokens Per Minute limit (e.g. `2000000`) | Tier standard |
| `GEMINI_RPM_LIMIT` | Override Requests Per Minute limit (e.g. `1000`) | Tier standard |
| `GEMINI_RPD_LIMIT` | Override Daily Requests limit (e.g. `10000`) | Tier standard |
| `GEMINI_CURRENCY` | Currency code (`IDR` or `USD`) | Auto from billing account |
| `GEMINI_EXCHANGE_RATE`| Exchange rate for USD to IDR conversion | `16000` |
| `GCLOUD_PATH` | Path to `gcloud` binary for ADC billing lookup | Auto-detected |

## 📐 Rate Limits Reference

### Gemini 3.8 Flash
| Tier | RPM | TPM (Input) | RPD (Daily) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free Tier** | 5 | 250,000 | 20 |
| **Tier 1** | 1,000 | 2,000,000 (2M) | 10,000 |
| **Tier 2** | 2,000 | 3,000,000 (3M) | 100,000 |
| **Tier 3** | 4,000 | 6,000,000 (6M) | 200,000 |

### Gemini 2.5 Pro
| Tier | RPM | TPM (Input) | RPD (Daily) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free Tier** | 2 | 32,000 | 50 |
| **Tier 1** | 360 | 2,000,000 (2M) | 5,000 |
| **Tier 2** | 1,000 | 4,000,000 (4M) | 10,000 |
| **Tier 3** | 2,000 | 8,000,000 (8M) | 20,000 |

Useful links:
- **Google AI Studio Rate Limits**: https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit
- **Google Cloud Console Billing**: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.4] - 2026-09-28

### Fixed
- **Standalone Packaging & Zero-Dependency Install**: Set production `dependencies` to `{}` and moved `@opencode/plugin` to optional peer dependencies, resolving `NpmInstallFailedError` on Windows 11 where OpenCode's npm plugin installer attempted to resolve workspace dependency `@opencode-ai/plugin@local`.
- **Inlined Plugin Definition**: Inlined `Plugin.define` in `src/index.ts` so the server plugin entrypoint loads standalone without requiring `@opencode/plugin` in `node_modules`.

## [1.0.3] - 2026-09-28

### Fixed
- **Windows 11 Compatibility**: Replaced Unix `which` with cross-platform Google Cloud SDK binary discovery (`where.exe` on Windows and standard `%LOCALAPPDATA%`/`%ProgramFiles%` directory checks).
- **Console Cleanliness**: Suppressed `stderr` on child process lookups with `stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "ignore"]`, preventing `'which' is not recognized` error messages in Windows command prompts.

## [1.0.2] - 2026-09-28

### Added
- **Live Google Cloud Monitoring Telemetry Sync**: Dynamically queries Google Cloud Monitoring (`monitoring.googleapis.com`) for monthly project input and output tokens, keeping `This Month` and `All-Time` spend synchronized with Google AI Studio in real time.
- **Dynamic Project Spend Calculation**: Eliminated static spend baseline and replaced it with live project telemetry queried via authenticated `gcloud` credentials.

## [1.0.1] - 2026-09-28

### Added
- **Google Cloud ADC Billing Account Sync (Approach D)**: Discovers active Google Cloud billing accounts via authenticated `gcloud` credentials in the background, automatically localizing spend into Indonesian Rupiah (`IDR`) matching Google AI Studio dashboards, with dual USD/IDR conversion.
- **Dynamic Color Saturation Meters**: Visual mini saturation meters (`[████░░]`) with Green (`< 65%`), Amber (`65%–85%`), and Red (`> 85%`) status color-coding across both values and meter bars matching `Token Usage` aesthetic.
- **Custom Quota Overrides**: Added `GEMINI_TPM_LIMIT`, `GEMINI_RPM_LIMIT`, `GEMINI_RPD_LIMIT`, `GEMINI_CURRENCY`, and `GEMINI_EXCHANGE_RATE` environment variables.

### Fixed
- **TPM Sliding Window Calculation**: Included prompt context caching (`cache.read`) into input TPM calculation, matching Google AI Studio's 1.47M / 2M peak calculations.
- **Rate Limit Quota Alignment**: Aligned Gemini 3.8 Flash Tier 1 TPM limit to 2,000,000 (2M) per Google AI Studio specifications.
- **In-Memory Reactivity**: Bound rate limit calculations directly to OpenCode's in-memory session messages (`context.data.session.message.list`) with 1-second clock decay, eliminating delayed disk writes.
- **Sidebar Text Wrapping**: Prevented multi-line text breaking on narrow terminal viewports (~25–29 chars) and separated Today and This Month rows in Spend overview.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-28

### Added
- **Initial Release**: OpenCode V2 plugin for real-time tracking of Google Gemini API Key Usage, Rate Limits (RPM, TPM, RPD), Spend (USD), and Billing.
- **Zero-Setup Authentication**: Automatically extracts Google Gemini credentials from OpenCode's local database (`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`) with zero external native C dependencies, supporting both Bun (`bun:sqlite`) and Node.js (`node:sqlite`).
- **Environment Fallback**: Supports `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `GOOGLE_API_KEY` environment variables.
- **Live Sliding-Window Rate Limits**:
  - Real-time 60-second sliding window for **Requests Per Minute (RPM)** and **Tokens Per Minute (TPM)** with a 1-second clock decay.
  - Accounts for full input context throughput including Prompt Context Caching (`cache.read`).
  - Daily quota tracking (**RPD**) reset at midnight Pacific Time.
- **Tier-Aware Quotas**:
  - Automatically identifies Gemini tier: `Free`, `Tier 1`, `Tier 2`, or `Tier 3` based on model catalog access and spend history.
  - Configurable model-specific rate limits for `gemini-3.8-flash` (2M TPM, 1k RPM in Tier 1 per Google AI Studio specifications) and Pro models.
  - Custom quota overrides via `GEMINI_TPM_LIMIT`, `GEMINI_RPM_LIMIT`, and `GEMINI_RPD_LIMIT`.
- **Accurate Spend & Cost Analytics**:
  - Real-time session spend bound to OpenCode's in-memory session store (`context.data.session.cost`).
  - Tiered spend overview: Current Session, Today, This Month, and All-Time in USD.
  - Model distribution tracking across Gemini families.
- **Dynamic Color Meter Bars**:
  - Visual mini saturation meters (`[████░░]`) matching OpenCode's theme token system.
  - Green (`< 65%`), Amber (`65%–85%`), and Red (`> 85%`) status color-coding across both values and meter bars.
- **OpenCode TUI Integration**:
  - **Collapsible Sidebar Widget** (`sidebar.content`): Clean, narrow-sidebar safe layout (~25–29 characters) with persistent collapse state via `context.storage.store`.
  - **Footer Status Bar** (`home.footer.status`): Lightweight real-time ticker showing current spend and RPM.
- **Google Cloud ADC Billing Account Sync (Approach D)**:
  - Discovers active Google Cloud billing accounts via authenticated `gcloud` credentials in the background.
  - Automatically localizes currency into Indonesian Rupiah (`IDR`) matching Google AI Studio dashboards, with dual USD/IDR conversion.
- **OpenCode Agent Tool (`gemini_usage_report`)**:
  - Built-in server plugin tool allowing OpenCode agents to programmatically query live usage, active rate limits, and billing metrics.
